data.one_liner: Display a list of items grouped into a ListView, GridView, or custom scroll view.
data.what_it_does: Provides a widget to display a grouped list of items using a provided list and grouper function. It supports sticky headers, custom headers and footers, and built-in checkbox or radio selection functionality within the scroll view.
use_when: You need to display data grouped by a specific property (like year or category).
You want to render grouped items as a grid or a list with sticky headers.
You need built-in checkbox or radio selection features inside a grouped scroll view.
avoid_when: You just need a standard un-grouped ListView or GridView.
You require complex state management solutions beyond simple item toggling.
strengths: Supports both list and grid views for grouped data.
Includes sticky header, custom header, and custom footer builders.
Provides checkbox and radio toggle controller capabilities.
weaknesses: Toggle controllers require manual disposal depending on the version flow.
data.minimal_example:
GroupedScrollView.list(
  groupedOptions: GroupedScrollViewOptions(
    itemGrouper: (Person person) => person.birthYear,
    stickyHeaderBuilder: (BuildContext context, int year, int groupedIndex) => Text('$year'),
  ),
  itemBuilder: (BuildContext context, Person item) => Text(item.name),
  data: DataCache.instance.persons,
)
